 version 7.1.070, Release 1201

 sysname sw-q51
#
 lacp system-priority 4096
#
 dhcp snooping enable
#
 stp mode mstp
 stp root primary
 stp timer hello 200
 stp timer forward-delay 1500
 stp timer max-age 2000
 stp instance 1 root primary
 stp instance 2 priority 8192
 stp global enable
#
stp region-configuration
 region-name sample-region
 revision-level 3
 instance 1 vlan 10 20
 instance 2 vlan 30 to 32
 active region-configuration
#
vlan 10
 name sample-office
#
vlan 20
#
vlan 30 to 32
#
interface Bridge-Aggregation1
 port link-type trunk
 port trunk permit vlan 10 20 30 to 32
 link-aggregation mode dynamic
#
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 port access vlan 10
 stp root-protection
 stp cost 20000
 stp port priority 64
 broadcast-suppression kbps 64
 unicast-suppression pps 1000
#
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/2
 port access vlan 20
 stp loop-protection
#
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/3
 port access vlan 20
#
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/23
 port link-type trunk
 port trunk permit vlan 10 20 30 to 32
 dhcp snooping trust
 lacp period short
 port link-aggregation group 1
#
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24
 port link-type trunk
 port trunk permit vlan 10 20 30 to 32
 dhcp snooping trust
 port link-aggregation group 1
#
 mirroring-group 1 local
 mirroring-group 1 mirroring-port GigabitEthernet1/0/1 both
 mirroring-group 1 mirroring-port GigabitEthernet1/0/2 outbound
 mirroring-group 1 monitor-port GigabitEthernet1/0/3
#
return
